topics.inclusion_rule: Include studies that decode text, speech or acoustic features from video of the articulators (lip or face camera, ultrasound tongue imaging) with a trained network, and classify how temporal context enters the image front end: 3D (spatiotemporal) convolution over a frame stack, factorized (2+1)D convolution, a frame-wise 2D CNN followed by a recurrent layer, a temporal convolution network, or ConvLSTM. Boundary: hand-crafted features without a learned front end, audio-only models, contour tracking without speech output and reviews still count as pattern matches (an upper bound); a study can match several designs; versions count once by key.

Vocal-tract MRI studies (real-time, dynamic or cine MRI; 88 unique ledger studies whose ledger text names rtMRI, real-time or dynamic MRI, MRI-TIMIT, USC-TIMIT or the Vocal Tract Morphology MRI database), classified by what the study outputs: a descriptive analysis, an intermediate signal (contours, parameters), a phone/VCV/articulation-class label or class sequence, synthesized speech, or text scored by WER/CER/PER. Boundary: fMRI and structural-only MRI are outside unless the ledger names one of the rtMRI terms; synthesized speech scored by ASR WER counts as speech output, not text; a study can match several designs (full-text pattern counts, upper bounds); versions count once.
